name: Distro 10 - 1.2g Injected Pre Roll - Purple Plum
description:
Big flavor, extra kick. The Distro 10 Purple Plum pre-roll is a 1.2-gram infused joint, packed with quality flower and injected with distillate and terpenes for a bolder, more potent smoke. No device, no charging, just spark and go.

Built on the Purple Plum strain, this one brings a rich, fruit-forward profile: sweet, ripe plum and dark berry notes up front with a jammy, candy-like sweetness and a smooth, subtly earthy finish. It's a flavorful, easygoing smoke made for anyone who likes their sessions sweet, deep, and full of taste.

Why you'll love it:

1.2G infused pre-roll — quality flower injected with distillate and terpenes for extra potency
Purple Plum strain — sweet stone fruit and dark berry with an earthy backbone
Rich Purple Plum flavor — ripe plum and berry with a smooth, jammy finish
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in one ready-to-smoke joint. Distro 10 Purple Plum is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
